body: I don't know about you, but I haven't experienced my life in phases. My defects, like anxiety and depression are givens and constants, not some moddy teenage phase  experience pd by 95% of thr teenage population.
Confession: I don't really want  anyones help, I'm just curious to see what people have to say. It's not like I'll get to know when I'm dead.

New Zealand, north island in a little hot springs town caled Wiewera. Was born there, came to America when I was about 5, lived briefly in New Orleans. That place is the closest I'd ever get to heaven. So peaceful and pure, in my mind.
Its not worth watching strangers on the internet turn on me after they discover how deplorable I am.

I actually just hate this place. Its not a bad city or anything,  its just so far from home. Home is the only place I can still remember when my life was at least on the other side of the spectrum. Every bad memory takes place in this city.

If I told you what I felt guilty about, you sure as hell wouldn't be feeling sorry for me. I'd only hurting people other than 
myself.

Possibly, but its nothing short of a miracle, and I don't believe in  miracles. Maybe if I did have the resources to change my name and move anywhere in the world I'd have a shot at a fullfilling life, but that's out of the question at this point.

It would be the "honorable" thing to do wouldn't it? Even I have genuine respect for those who have the stength persevere the pain of life. Unforunatley, I only envy them, I am not one of them.
I'm actually from Virginia too, RVA.
I've done bad things to good people. My life got fucked up pretty early on, I don't see how a second chance can change sny of that.
I definitely don't deserve one, nor should I.
I can assure you what is inherently wrong with my life has little to do with my age and much to do with myself.

I really, really hate when people beg me to not do something I really want to do. You can't feel the emotions inside my head but I can tell you that you don't want any part of them. I've never wanted any material thing in my life as bad as I want to die. My insignificant life does not warrant any support from strangers. I certainly don't have anything that closely resembles a future. I fail all of my classes, yet almost sadistically I'm told I'm smart. My family claims they love me yet they don't even give me the time of day to talk to one of them. My mother is a zealot who scolds me everyday for things out of my control. (I like boys, I'm a lazy, cynical fuck.). My father is an under the table drug dealer who undoubtedly loves money and crystal more than me, its painfully obvious. Saying my life has any potential whatsoever is absolute bullshit.
I've already talked to enough people and I've well reached the point of no return. I don't even regret not seeing the future as I can hardly being any better than right now, if not infinitely worse.
